subtitle: Amapuzzle amakheji ezibalo
short_description: Gcwalisa igridi ye-4×4 ukuze wonke amakheji afinyelele inani lezibalo lawo.
description:
Gcwalisa igridi ye-4×4 ngamadijithi angu-1 kuya ku-4 ukuze idijithi ingaphindi kumugqa noma kukholomu. Ikheji ngalinye elinombala linesihloso esakhiwe ngesamba, umkhiqizo, umehluko, isabelo noma inani elilodwa, nezinombolo ezingaphakathi kumelwe zilifinyelele.

Thepha iseli bese uthayipha idijithi ku-keypad enkulu. Ukusula kususa inombolo esele eselini.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
